content_fields.title: Restrict the size of incoming messages in services
content_fields.description: Enforce a maximum accepted message size for every service endpoint.
content_fields.finding: No maximum request size is enforced at the application or middleware layer.
content_fields.current_code:
app = FastAPI(
        title=settings.TITLE,
        description=settings.DESCRIPTION,
        version=settings.VERSION,
        servers=settings.SERVERS,
        root_path=settings.ROOT_PATH,
        docs_url=None,
        redoc_url=None,
    )
content_fields.required_fix:
# app/init_app.py
MAX_BODY_BYTES = 1 * 1024 * 1024        # general JSON payloads
MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024      # routes that accept binary content

app.add_middleware(BodySizeLimitMiddleware, max_bytes=MAX_BODY_BYTES)
criteria: A global body-size ceiling is applied by middleware, not per handler.
Routes needing a larger ceiling opt in explicitly rather than the default being generous.
